角.issue: 四格内白的中横仍显厚，末钩的回锋曲线保留了通用黑体的长尾。优先略开中横两侧留白，并缩短回锋端。

edge_replacements.reason: 把末钩回锋端从微弧收尾改成明确斜截；端点仍用变更后的5.23

Regular.expected_effect: 中横65→59 UPM；末钩回锋缩短16 UPM，不移动主体竖钩。

Medium.expected_effect: 中横80→72 UPM；对较重的Display保留足够笔画厚度。

色.issue: 下部乚左下的大圆弧最容易显得像思源原字；建议仅把这个转弯改为有内外平行边的短斜折，保持顶端斜撇与中部两格原有结构。

Regular.expected_effect: 左下内外斜折均为45度，法向厚度约69 UPM，与原72 UPM竖笔和68 UPM底横接近；右端只平截帽口，不改钩的承力曲线。

Medium.expected_effect: 内外45度斜折的法向厚度约88 UPM，与原90 UPM竖笔和85 UPM底横接近。

色.implementation_note: 替换路径会增加节点数；按原轮廓和原edge索引一次性重放操作，不要逐条插入后继续使用旧node索引。

技.issue: 扌上横右端与支上横左端在相同高度区间只隔14 UPM，窄化后极易黏成连续横线。先打开这处局部空间，再考虑底部捺端造型。

Regular.expected_effect: 上横组件间距14→34 UPM；左竖钩回锋缩短12 UPM并采用斜截，与角的端部规则呼应。

Medium.expected_effect: 上横组件间距14→38 UPM，Display仍保持明显字重。

技.do_not_change: 右下交叉点和支的两条主弧当前结构清楚，不建议为追求几何感改成尖锐直线。

能.issue: 右侧上下两个匕的垂直间隔只有Regular 28 / Medium 26 UPM，小字号容易黏连；左月内白也可略打开。

Regular.expected_effect: 右部上下间距28→38 UPM；左月中横59→53 UPM；两个右钩口改用一致的平截帽口。

Medium.expected_effect: 右部上下间距26→38 UPM；左月中横72→64 UPM。

能.do_not_change: 保留台头的斜势以及匕的主要上挑曲线；不把整字改成机械方框。

Regular.expected_effect: Lift and shorten the upper-right lower bar; lighten the layer transition; shorten the lower-left turn and flatten its terminal.

Medium.expected_effect: Lift and shorten the upper-right lower bar; lighten the layer transition; shorten the lower-left turn and flatten its terminal.

装.issue: Upper/lower layer density and the sweeping lower-left turn need local adjustment.

Regular.expected_effect: Open all four lower counters toward the middle bars; keep the outer frame fixed; use straight cut faces on the two upper sweeping stroke ends.

Medium.expected_effect: Open all four lower counters toward the middle bars; keep the outer frame fixed; use straight cut faces on the two upper sweeping stroke ends.

备.issue: The four lower counters are too dense in the condensed shape.

Regular.expected_effect: Separate the stone and horn components by 12 source units without changing advance; open the right counters; shorten and flatten the lower hook return.

Medium.expected_effect: Separate the stone and horn components by 12 source units without changing advance; open the right counters; shorten and flatten the lower hook return.

确.issue: Stone/horn components are close, with a dense right-side grid and long hook return.

Regular.expected_effect: Straighten the speech dot edges; retract the raised terminal by 18 units and shorten its turn; flatten the two person-foot cut faces, keeping the main curved strokes.

Medium.expected_effect: Straighten the speech dot edges; retract the raised terminal by 18 units and shorten its turn; flatten the two person-foot cut faces, keeping the main curved strokes.

认.issue: The speech dot and raised hook have soft sweeping terminals which can be made more definite.
